name: Barbell Decline Wide-Grip Bench Press
steps: Set a moderate decline, secure your feet under the pads and lie back with a wide overhand grip.
Set your shoulders against the bench, brace your trunk and unrack the bar over your shoulders.
Lower the bar smoothly to your lower chest while keeping your forearms vertical underneath your hands.
Press the bar straight back up until your elbows extend fully.
tips: Choose a grip width that lets your shoulder blades stay pinned against the bench.
Keep your elbows slightly below shoulder level rather than flaring them toward your ears.
